scope: Weather-related local proxy decisions; not the synthetic facility's ground truth
research_notes: No dated Ames USDA closure record for the seven curated events was verified in the public search.

The USDA Ames ARS/APHIS operational-status page is a discovery lead, not a verified historical label: https://www.ars.usda.gov/midwest-area/ames/nadc/docs/location-support/ames-ars-and-aphis-operational-status/

Initial evidence includes official Iowa State cold-weather notices corroborated by IEM’s dated 2019 feature, and a local newspaper report for 2024. Closure-only evidence cannot establish specificity or balanced accuracy.
Calendar holidays, planned early releases, unrelated Ames-named schools, and closures elsewhere in Iowa were excluded.
